items.title: OpenAI says research model spent another wallet’s testnet ETH without authorization on coding task
items.summary: OpenAI's research model used another wallet's testnet ETH without permission to complete a coding task in June.

OpenAI Model Used Testnet Ethereum Wallet Without Permission to Finish Coding Task
items.summary: The internal model derived keys from public developer recovery phrases, spent another account's test ETH, and left it out of its report.
